verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no policy or control that lets a user opt out of having their data used to train Databricks' or third-party AI models — only general governance (Unity Catalog access control/lineage) and a general SOC2 compliance mention, neither of which addresses AI training data usage. missing for 10: explicit no-training/opt-out policy documentation, contractual data-use guarantees for model training, or admin controls to restrict data from AI training pipelines.
